valid.prepared-create-record.json: Prepared exclusive-create operation with no canonical durability.
valid.staged-create-record.json: Complete valid candidate and acquired lock snapshot before canonical mutation.
valid.committed-lifecycle-transition.json: Accepted canonical gates with an ordinary derived rebuild remaining post-commit.

invalid.revision-one-with-predecessor.json: Revision one must not identify a predecessor.
invalid.prepared-commit-reached.json: Prepared state cannot claim the canonical commit point.
invalid.must-match-without-fingerprint.json: must_match requires an exact content fingerprint.
invalid.committed-canonical-step-pending.json: Committed state requires every canonical-gate step to be accepted.

noncontiguous-step-sequence.json.description: Write-step sequences must be contiguous and agree with array order.

duplicate-step-id.json.description: Step identifiers must be unique within one complete write set.

nonimmediate-journal-predecessor.json.description: A revision greater than one must identify the exact immediately preceding revision.

staged-destination-mismatch.json.description: A staged artifact must identify the same destination as its write step.

completed-lock-still-acquired.json.description: A completed operation must not retain acquired target locks.
